svg.aria-label: Chen ER diagram for DevMatch AI
svg.text: All 10 website entities are strong entities. The current design contains no weak entities.
Child entities have their own IDs. Depending on a parent through a foreign key does not make them weak.
M : N Developer profile — Job, resolved through Application (one application per developer and job)
1 = exactly one 0..1 = zero or one 0..N = zero or many 1 : N = one-to-many M : N = many-to-many
*A user may have zero or one profile of each type. Each profile belongs to exactly one user.
